source: Official NYSE core-session policy, CME customary roll dates, BLS/BEA/Federal Reserve Board schedules; fixed MNQ December 2026 Sim101 snapshot; official dated CME MNQ Globex hours and contract specification
purpose: R2 full-session Sim101 paper experiment for futures trading dates October 7-30, 2026. Earlier rows are cash ATR20 warmup only. Review/refresh later dates before trading.
contract_policy: MNQ 12-26 throughout, including pre-roll warmup. Use actual individual December-contract history; do not substitute September or back-adjusted continuous prices. This is not a front-month research series.
session_policy: 09:30-16:00 America/New_York core cash session. NYSE Labor Day 2026-09-07 excluded. No scheduled early closes in this window. CME customary US-index roll 2026-09-14 marked and not tradable.
news_coverage: All timed entries in the cited BLS, BEA and Federal Reserve Board monthly schedules for included dates. Includes CPI, payrolls, GDP, FOMC decisions/press conferences, Board speeches and statistical releases. No claim of an exhaustive all-provider, all-speaker news feed or unscheduled-event coverage.
revision_policy: Retained official schedules are frozen snapshots, not a live news service. Historical warmup hours were reviewed retrospectively; forward R2 begins only after installation. Release revision markers are unknown (null). Preserve the snapshot and refresh schedules before later trading dates; do not treat it as point-in-time research data.
